section_summary.extract_value: This Results section describes a structural equation model analysis examining relationships between appearance and health goals, four types of regulations (external, introjected, identified, intrinsic), and body image. Body image was modeled as a latent construct using PASTAS, BAS, and WST discrepancies as indicators. The analysis found that appearance goals had a strong negative direct association with body image and a significant indirect negative association via introjected regulation, with BMI and activity level included as covariates in the model.
